spans.s:
फर n. (-रं) A shield.
 E. र substituted for ल; see फल ।

फर्फर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One moving quickly.
 E. स्फुर्-अच् ।

फर्फरीक m. (-कः) The Palm of the hand with the fingers extended.
 n.
(-कं) Young shoot or branch.
 f. (-का) A shoe.

फरीक m. (-कः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended.
 n. (-कं)
Sweetness.
 E. स्फुर् to expand, Unādi aff. ईकन् and the form irr.
